adapter_metadata.adapter_initialization: A: normal(0, 0.02); B: zero; RNG not seeded by --seed
adapter_metadata.adapter_target: all decoder attention q/k/v/o and MLP gate/up/down projections; absent shared-KV v_proj excluded
adapter_metadata.quantized_backward: first-order input gradients; one transient F32 dequantized projection; frozen base weights
adapter_metadata.quantized_loading: one dense decoder layer at a time, immediately quantized; no dense base copy retained
adapter_metadata.quantized_matmul_input_dtype: f32 for Candle CUDA fallback compatibility; output cast to compute dtype
adapter_metadata.reload: warm start only; optimizer and data-order restart
adapter_metadata.seed_scope: data order only, not scratch initialization

forwarded_position_convention: For G > 0: forwarded_tokens = P + G - 1; maximum zero-based position = P + G - 2. The final sampled token is not forwarded. For G = 0: no forward, maximum position null.
prompt: <bos>The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
synthetic_prompt_method: repeat seed token IDs, preserving initial BOS once when seed has other tokens; truncate to exact size
timing_convention: Device synchronized around each forward; forward timings include input upload, exclude sampling/output. Generation wall includes sampling and streamed output.
